# Story 01 — Notes and the attachment subsystem (Story: 501)

## Prerequisites

- Story 500 (3.1 Customer core record) completed: the `customers` table and API must exist so notes and attachments have a record to hang on. See `.squad/stories/inti/500/intake.md`.
- Story 494 (2.3 Settings) completed or scaffolded so the **upload allow-list** and **size cap** are runtime-readable settings, not compile-time constants. See `.squad/stories/inti/494/intake.md`.
- Coordinate with the owner of the Tickets module (T3) and any future Messages surface, since `attachments` is polymorphic over a **closed set of three owner types** (`customer`, `ticket`, `message`) and lives in Platform (T0). Owners must not add a foreign key from `attachments` back to their module.

---

## Story Goal

Deliver two related capabilities:

1. **Notes on customers.** Any agent can add free-text notes stamped with author + timestamp; the author can edit or delete their own note; a Supervisor can delete any note.
2. **Attachment subsystem.** A single polymorphic `attachments` table (owned by Platform T0) accepts files for exactly three owner kinds — `customer`, `ticket`, `message`. Uploads land in a private `quarantine/` prefix, are validated (allow-list + size cap from settings, **server-side MIME sniff**, never trust client MIME), and are queued for scan via a `FileScanner` port. On clean, the object moves to `clean/`; on failure, it is refused with a reason and stays undownloadable. Download is only ever a **short-lived signed URL** from object storage with `Content-Disposition: attachment` and a non-executable content type. If the scanner is unreachable, uploads succeed and remain quarantined — nothing else breaks.

**Not in scope:** inline previews of attachments; ticket-owner and message-owner UI surfaces (this story only wires the Customer surface end-to-end; ticket/message owners are supported at the model/API level for Story 4.4 to consume). Antivirus deployment/config for production ClamAV is out of scope — only the port + null adapter + interface for a ClamAV adapter is delivered.

## Product rules (from story)

**Current behaviour**

- Customers module has no notes and no attachment surface (only `Domain/Placeholder.php`).
- No `attachments` or `notes` table exists in `backend/database/migrations/`.
- No `FileScanner` port and no scan job exist.

**New behaviour**

- Notes:
  - Free text; each note stamped with **author user id** and **created_at / updated_at**.
  - Author can `PATCH` and `DELETE` their own note.
  - A Supervisor role can `DELETE` any note. (Role check via the Security module's authorization primitives; if a role gate is not yet in place, gate on a policy method `deleteAny` and TODO-link to Security follow-up in code comments.)
- Attachments:
  - `attachments` is polymorphic with a **type discriminator column** `owner_type` restricted to the closed set `{customer, ticket, message}` (enum/check-constraint), plus `owner_id` (ULID string). **No FK** to owner tables.
  - Columns include: `id` (ULID), `owner_type`, `owner_id`, `filename` (original), `stored_path` (`quarantine/…` then `clean/…`), `byte_size`, `mime_type` (server-sniffed), `uploader_id`, `uploaded_at`, `scan_status` (`pending|clean|failed`), `scan_result` (nullable JSON with reason), `scanned_at` (nullable), `created_at`, `updated_at`.
  - Upload flow: multipart POST → validate against **runtime settings** (allow-list, size cap) → **sniff MIME server-side** using `finfo` and reject on mismatch with client-supplied MIME → write to `quarantine/{ulid}` on a private disk → insert `attachments` row with `scan_status='pending'` → dispatch `ScanAttachmentJob` → **return 201** with row (state=`pending`, `downloadable=false`).
  - Scan job: resolves `FileScanner` from the container. On `clean`: `Storage::move` from `quarantine/` to `clean/`, set `scan_status='clean'`, `scanned_at`. On `failed`: keep in `quarantine/`, set `scan_status='failed'`, `scan_result={reason}`. On **transport error** (scanner unreachable): keep `pending`, log, do **not** fail the job in a way that surfaces to the user; upload remains quarantined.
  - Download: `GET /attachments/{id}/download` — 403 unless `scan_status='clean'`, otherwise redirect (302) to a short-lived signed URL (≤ 5 minutes) issued directly by the object-storage driver, with `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="…"` and a non-executable `Content-Type` (never `text/html` or `application/xhtml+xml`; map unknown to `application/octet-stream`).
  - Never trust the client-supplied MIME type in either upload or download.
  - No inline preview endpoint of any kind.

### 6 — Upload endpoint

**Create file:** `backend/app/Modules/Platform/Http/Controllers/AttachmentsController.php`

Endpoints (register in `backend/routes/api.php`, guarded by `auth:sanctum`):

- `POST /api/v1/attachments`
  - Multipart body: `owner_type`, `owner_id`, `file`.
  - Validation:
    - `owner_type in [customer,ticket,message]`.
    - `owner_id` present and ULID-shaped.
    - `file` uploaded and ≤ `AttachmentSettings::maxBytes()`.
    - Server-sniff MIME via `finfo_file` on the temp path; reject with `422` (`type=/problems/attachment-mime-mismatch`) if sniffed MIME is not in the allow-list, **or** if it disagrees with `$file->getClientMimeType()`.
  - On success:
    - Generate ULID for row and for stored key.
    - `Storage::disk('attachments')->putFileAs('quarantine', $file, $id)`.
    - Insert row (`scan_status=pending`, `mime_type = sniffed`).
    - `dispatch(new ScanAttachmentJob($id))`.
    - Respond `201` with attachment resource + `downloadable: false`.
  - Honour Idempotency-Key (existing middleware auto-covers this on POST — verify by reading `IdempotencyKey.php`).
- `GET /api/v1/attachments/{id}` → row + computed `downloadable = (scan_status === 'clean')`.
- `GET /api/v1/attachments/{id}/download`
  - 403 (`type=/problems/attachment-not-downloadable`) unless `scan_status='clean'`.
  - Otherwise, issue a signed URL via the disk (`Storage::disk('attachments')->temporaryUrl($stored_path, now()->addMinutes(5), ['ResponseContentDisposition' => 'attachment; filename="…"', 'ResponseContentType' => $safeContentType])`).
  - Respond `302` redirect. **Never** stream bytes through the application origin.
  - `$safeContentType` is the sniffed MIME, but coerced to `application/octet-stream` when it starts with `text/html`, `application/xhtml`, `image/svg+xml`, or any `*script*` value.

**Error bodies** — throw `ProblemException` subclasses; do **not** hand-build JSON in the controller (see `NoControllerErrorBodiesTest`).

### 7 — Scan job

**Create file:** `backend/app/Modules/Platform/Jobs/ScanAttachmentJob.php`

- `implements ShouldQueue`.
- Constructor takes attachment id (string).
- `handle(FileScanner $scanner, Filesystem $disk)`:
  - Load attachment; if not `pending`, no-op.
  - Get absolute path (or stream) from the disk.
  - `try { $result = $scanner->scan(...); }`
    - `catch (ScannerUnreachable)`: log at warning level, `return` (leave `pending`; job retries via `$tries` limit; when retries exhaust, leave quarantined). Also `release($delay)` if within retries.
  - If `$result->status === 'clean'`:
    - `$disk->move('quarantine/'.$id, 'clean/'.$id)`;
    - update columns `scan_status='clean'`, `scanned_at=now()`.
  - Else: `scan_status='failed'`, `scan_result=['reason'=>$result->reason]`, `scanned_at=now()`, **do not move** the file.
- Set `public int $tries = 5;` and `public int $backoff = 30;`.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Client MIME mismatch:** client sends `image/png` but `finfo` reports `text/html`. Reject `422` `type=/problems/attachment-mime-mismatch`, do not persist the file. Enforced in `AttachmentsController::store`.
- **Oversize upload:** file > `AttachmentSettings::maxBytes()`. Reject `422` `type=/problems/attachment-too-large`. PHP-level `upload_max_filesize` / `post_max_size` must also be configured; document in `backend/README.md` (out of scope to change infra).
- **Unknown owner_type:** rejected `422`. The DB check constraint is a belt-and-braces guard.
- **Owner_id does not exist:** for `customer` we can look up; for `ticket`/`message` we cannot (no cross-module dep). Accept the id if ULID-shaped; leave existence enforcement to the owning module's controller when it constructs the upload flow. Document this trade-off in a code comment above the validator.
- **Scanner unreachable at scan time:** `ScannerUnreachable` caught in job; leaves `pending`; retries with backoff; ultimately leaves quarantined. Upload was already 201. Enforced in `ScanAttachmentJob::handle`.
- **Scanner returns "failed":** row transitions to `failed`, file remains in `quarantine/`. Download endpoint returns 403. Enforced in `AttachmentsController::download` and the job.
- **Signed URL replay:** URLs are ≤ 5 min TTL; regenerated on every `download` call. No caching on the response.
- **Executable content types:** even for `clean` attachments, if sniffed MIME is `text/html`, `application/xhtml+xml`, `image/svg+xml`, or `*script*`, override `Content-Type` to `application/octet-stream` in the signed URL. Enforced in `AttachmentsController::download`.
- **Note edit by non-author:** 403 Problem Details. Enforced in `CustomerNotesController::update`.
- **Note delete by non-author non-supervisor:** 403 Problem Details. Enforced in `CustomerNotesController::destroy`.
- **Unicode filename:** preserved verbatim in DB `filename`; percent-encoded in `Content-Disposition` per RFC 5987 when issuing the signed URL.
- **Concurrent uploads with same Idempotency-Key:** returned response replayed by existing `IdempotencyKey.php` middleware; the second physical upload is not stored (verify by reading the middleware).
- **Half-scanned state on job crash:** worker crash mid-move leaves the file in `quarantine/` and row in `pending`. On retry, the job's early "already-not-pending" guard is skipped; the `move` is idempotent because destination `clean/{id}` did not yet exist — but if it did (rare), catch the "target exists" error and treat as success.
- **Partial migration:** if `attachments` table exists but `notes` does not (or vice versa), the app must still boot. Migrations are independent files.

## Migration / Rollback

- Migrations are additive; rollback is `php artisan migrate:rollback --step=2` which drops `notes` then `attachments`. Uploaded files under `storage/app/attachments/{quarantine,clean}/…` are **not** removed by rollback — document a one-line cleanup command in the migration's `down()` comment; do not automate deletion.
- Half-applied state (e.g. `attachments` created, `notes` not): benign. Attachment endpoints work; notes endpoints 500 on model boot — mitigate by keeping the two migrations sequential (attachments first, notes second) and by feature-flagging the notes routes behind a `Schema::hasTable('notes')` guard registered in `CustomersServiceProvider`.
- If the queue is not draining, uploads still succeed and remain quarantined — matches the accepted-behaviour rule "if the scanner is unreachable, uploads still succeed". No rollback needed.

## Verification Steps

1. **Backend builds & tests:** from `backend/`, run `composer install`, then `php artisan migrate:fresh`, then `./vendor/bin/phpunit`. All new and existing tests green.
2. **Backend OpenAPI:** from `backend/`, run `php artisan openapi:generate && php artisan openapi:check`. No diff, no errors.
3. **Backend architecture:** from `backend/`, run `./vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite=Architecture` (or the suite name in `phpunit.xml`). Green.
4. **Backend deptrac:** from `backend/`, run `./vendor/bin/deptrac analyse -c deptrac.yaml` and `./vendor/bin/deptrac analyse -c deptrac-tiers.yaml`. Zero violations.
5. **Frontend regenerates client:** from `frontend/`, run `node scripts/api-client.mjs` against a running backend, then `pnpm test`. All Vitest suites green — in particular `openapi-drift`, `messages-parity`, and the new NotesLane/AttachmentsLane suites.
6. **Frontend runs:** from `frontend/`, run `pnpm dev` and visually verify (against the mockup referenced in the intake) that the three attachment states render correctly in both `en` and `ar` locales (RTL toggle).
7. **Regression — Idempotency:** re-run `backend/tests/Feature/Platform/IdempotencyKeyTest.php` after upload endpoint lands — the middleware must still short-circuit on repeated POSTs.
8. **Regression — Problem Details:** re-run `backend/tests/Feature/Platform/ProblemDetailsTest.php`.
9. **Manual — Download safety:** from a shell, `curl -I` the download endpoint of a `clean` HTML file; assert 302, and the `Location` URL is a signed storage URL; then `curl` the storage URL and assert `Content-Disposition: attachment` and `Content-Type: application/octet-stream`.

## Done Criteria

- [x] Free-text notes can be added to a customer; each row records `author_id`, `created_at`, `updated_at`.
- [x] Note author can edit and delete their own note; Supervisor can delete any note; anyone else is 403.
- [x] `attachments` table exists in Platform with polymorphic `owner_type` restricted to `{customer, ticket, message}` and **no** FK to owner tables.
- [x] Each attachment records `filename`, `byte_size`, `mime_type` (server-sniffed), `uploader_id`, `uploaded_at`.
- [x] Upload is validated against the runtime allow-list and size cap sourced from Story 2.3 settings (verified by test that toggles the setting between runs).
- [x] Server-side `finfo` MIME sniff runs on every upload; client-supplied MIME is never trusted; mismatches return `422` Problem Details.
- [x] Uploaded files land under a private `quarantine/` prefix; moved to a private `clean/` prefix only on successful scan.
- [x] `ScanAttachmentJob` runs on the queue via a `FileScanner` port; `NullFileScanner` is bound by default (used in CI); a `ClamavFileScanner` exists behind a driver switch.
- [x] While `pending`, the attachment is visible with a "Pending scan" label and the download control is disabled (UX-10).
- [x] `failed` attachments show the reason and are never downloadable.
- [x] `GET /attachments/{id}/download` returns 403 unless `clean`; otherwise 302 to a ≤5-minute signed URL from object storage, with `Content-Disposition: attachment` and a non-executable content type.
- [x] No inline preview endpoints; frontend never inlines attachment content.
- [x] If the scanner is unreachable, uploads still return 201 and remain quarantined; nothing else in the app breaks.
- [x] `php artisan openapi:check` clean; all module-boundary, deptrac, and Vitest suites green.
